description: Build the complete Communications & Notifications module including seed data, storage functions, AppContext state, routing, sidebar navigation with notification badge, and all four tabbed sub-modules (Communication Log, Notification Center, Email Templates, Automated Alerts).
steps: Create src/data/seedCommunications.js with deterministic seed data generators for: communications (per-nurse history with type email/whatsapp/call/sms, channel, notes, date, nurseId, linked events), notifications (document expiry warnings, compliance alerts, pipeline stage changes, placement updates with read/unread state and timestamps), emailTemplates (welcome, status update, document request, placement confirmation categories with variable placeholders like {{nurse_name}}, {{cohort}}, {{dates}}), and alertRules (configurable rules like 'document expires in 30 days', 'compliance drops below 80%' with enabled/disabled state and history). Use the seededRandom pattern from seedDocuments.js.

Add storage functions in src/lib/storage.js: getCommunications/saveCommunications, getNotifications/saveNotifications, getEmailTemplates/saveEmailTemplates, getAlertRules/saveAlertRules. Add initialization logic in initializeData() that seeds communications data if not present, importing from seedCommunications.js.

Add state to src/context/AppContext.jsx: import new storage functions, add useState hooks for communications, notifications, emailTemplates, alertRules, add useCallback update functions (updateCommunications, updateNotifications, updateEmailTemplates, updateAlertRules), export all in value object.

Update src/components/layout/Sidebar.jsx: import MessageSquare (or Bell) icon from lucide-react, add Communications nav item to NAV_ITEMS array (path: '/communications', label: 'Communications', icon: MessageSquare) positioned between Documents and Settings. Add a notification badge (small red circle with unread count) next to the Communications label using useAppContext to get unread notification count.

Create src/pages/Communications.jsx as a tabbed page (following DocumentManagement.jsx pattern) with four tabs: Communication Log, Notification Center, Email Templates, Automated Alerts. Use lucide-react icons for each tab (MessageSquare, Bell, Mail, AlertTriangle or similar).

Create src/components/communications/CommunicationLog.jsx: display per-nurse communication history in a filterable table/list. Include: log new communication modal (type/channel/notes/date picker), filter by nurse (searchable dropdown), filter by date range, filter by channel type. Show linked outreach/pipeline events. Display entries as cards/rows with nurse name, type badge, date, preview of notes.

Create src/components/communications/NotificationCenter.jsx: in-app notification feed showing document expiry warnings, compliance alerts, pipeline stage changes, placement updates. Each notification shows icon, title, description, timestamp, read/unread state. Support mark as read/unread (individual and bulk), filter by type, and notification preferences section (toggle alerts by category).

Create src/components/communications/EmailTemplates.jsx: template builder with variable insertion ({{nurse_name}}, {{cohort}}, {{dates}}, etc.), preview panel with sample data substitution, categorized templates list (welcome, status update, document request, placement confirmation), create/edit/delete templates, send simulation button that logs to communication history.

Create src/components/communications/AutomatedAlerts.jsx: alert rule builder UI with condition fields (trigger type, threshold, entity), list of configured rules with enable/disable toggle, alert history/audit log showing triggered alerts with timestamps, create new rule modal, delete/edit existing rules.
Add route in src/App.jsx: import Communications page, add <Route path='/communications' element={<Communications />} /> inside the Layout route group, positioned between /documents and /settings.
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with zero errors
Route /communications renders the Communications page with four functional tabs
Sidebar shows Communications nav item with notification badge showing unread count
Communication Log tab displays seed data, supports adding new entries, and filtering by nurse/date/channel
Notification Center shows notifications with read/unread state and mark as read functionality
Email Templates tab shows categorized templates with variable preview and send simulation
Automated Alerts tab shows configurable rules with enable/disable toggle and alert history
verification: Run npm run build in /projects/sandbox/PropelaPlatform and confirm exit code 0 with no errors
